elicitation_input.question: role of malonyl coa in fatty acid synthesis

llm_generation.text: Malonyl-CoA is a key intermediate and building block in fatty acid synthesis. It is formed from acetyl-CoA by acetyl-CoA carboxylase and supplies two-carbon units for elongating fatty-acid chains. Its production is regulated by cellular energy and fatty-acid levels, including activation by citrate and feedback inhibition by palmitoyl-CoA. Malonyl-CoA also inhibits CPT1, preventing fatty acids from entering mitochondria for β-oxidation and thereby coordinating fatty-acid synthesis with breakdown.
